name: RC-B10-0133/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Azerbaijan to release people it says are held for their political views, to stop pressure on journalists and rights groups, and to respect the rights of Armenians who fled Nagorno-Karabakh. It asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Azerbaijani officials, to end gas reliance on Azerbaijan, and to back Armenia more strongly. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks for sanctions and a halt to the EU's energy partnership with Azerbaijan.
- It affects Azerbaijan's government, detainees, journalists, and Armenians displaced from Nagorno-Karabakh.
- Next, EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
